# Tracker ids already present in lib/.
# Read by the "no lib/ file gains a tracker id" test in
# test/statifier_examples/tracker_id_test.exs, which defines the id shape.
# One line per file and id: the file, the id, and how many times the file
# carries it, tab-separated. A new id is refused, not added here; a line is
# lowered or deleted when an id leaves its file.
